sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: [TO COMPLETE] Confirm account details, application fields, identity/education documents, emergency contacts, support messages, security logs, essential cookies and any analytics actually used.

sections.title: Why we use information and our lawful basis
sections.body: [TO COMPLETE] State each actual purpose and applicable lawful basis, including application advice, communications, account security and any marketing. Check the treatment of sensitive information and emergency-contact data.

sections.title: Who receives information
sections.body: [TO COMPLETE] Identify staff access, universities receiving submitted data, hosting/database/email providers, Google sign-in/Maps and other processors actually used. Explain when information is shared.

sections.title: Where information is processed
sections.body: [TO COMPLETE] Confirm hosting and processor regions, international transfers and relevant safeguards.

sections.title: How long we keep information
sections.body: [TO COMPLETE] Approve specific retention periods or criteria for accounts, drafts, submitted applications, documents, support messages, security logs, legacy files, backups and exported copies.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
sections.body: [TO COMPLETE] Explain how to request access, correction, deletion and other applicable rights, object or withdraw consent where relevant, and complain to the ICO. State the real contact and handling process.

sections.title: Cookies and external services
sections.body: [TO COMPLETE] Describe the essential session/MFA/OAuth cookies and saved interface preferences, as well as actual external sign-in/Maps requests. Confirm whether any nonessential tracking is deployed.
